channel.title: CNN 5 Things
channel.description: Monday through Friday get up to speed on the biggest headlines of the day with 5 Things. On Saturdays, get a break for your ears with good news from 5 Good Things. And at noon and Sundays, we take you beyond the headlines to help make sense of what everyone is talking about in politics and beyond with One Thing.

item.title: Lame-Duck Congress Prepares Vote to Impeach Hegseth
item.description: Congress is back in session for the first time since the midterms with an impeachment vote against Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth looming. President Donald Trump says he wants to work with Democrats on immigration – what could that look like? Gas prices are creeping down towards four dollars a gallon for the first time in months. Russell Brand has been sentenced to a decade in prison after being convicted of rape. And as the world’s biggest climate conference kicks off this week, a new report shows the climate and weather extremes endured by the planet are “off the charts.” Learn more about your ad choices. item.title: Where Does MAGA Go from Here?
item.itunes:title: Where Does MAGA Go from Here?
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
The GOP is doing some serious soul-searching after a midterm wipeout which saw the Democrats retake the House and Senate. With some fingers pointing at President Donald Trump and an impeachment vote against Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth looming, what should become of the MAGA movement? We take a temperature check from campus to Congress. 

--- 

Guests: Drake Riddle, Univ. of Iowa College Republicans & Rep. Greg Steube (R-FL) 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin

item.title: 'Wellness Darties': Gen Z is Reinventing the Frat Party
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
Forget the midterms — the votes are in for the new voice of Boston’s Logan Airport. Find out why college students across the country are partying with self-care in mind. As birdwatching booms among Gen Z, research suggests it could be an investment in your brain health. After a lifetime of medical challenges, Olivia DeKold found relief through an unusual intestinal procedure and a reason to believe in her future again. Plus, meet the New York City teen taking a unique approach to choosing a career. 

Host/Producer: Krista Bo Polanco 

Producer: Eryn Mathewson 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin 

Editorial Support: Daria Casalini, Julia Vargas Jones

item.title: What Democrats Plan to Do with Their Power in Congress
item.itunes:title: What Democrats Plan to Do with Their Power in Congress
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
Once Democrats take control in the House and Senate in January, what will they do with it? We examine why House leadership battles could become contentious and why an impeachment vote against Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth could happen even before new members are sworn in. 

--- 

Guest: Sarah Ferris, CNN Senior Reporter 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin
